summary: Read a nonnegative integer n. Count the integers x such that x is at least 0 and strictly less than ten to the power n, and such that all decimal digits of x are different from each other. The value zero counts as one such integer. Do not treat unwritten leading zeros as extra digits. Write that count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
